_sheet: Network events between the players of one PEAK lobby. One row = one Photon RaiseEvent code the mod sends. Generated/NetEvents.cs gets a struct per row with Write/Read (BinaryWriter/BinaryReader, little endian) built from the fields column.

_columns.code: Photon event code, byte. PEAK uses 1,2,3,4,18; PUN reserves 200+; the mod owns 90-119
_columns.name: struct name
_columns.fields: ordered list of {name, type}; types: byte, bool, int, float, double, string, byte[], int[]
_columns.handler: method in CampfireCards.Net that the dispatcher calls with the decoded struct and the sender actor number

rows.name: Hello
rows.purpose: announce the mod, its card count and a hash of the deck so players on different versions get a warning

rows.name: PickSessionStart
rows.purpose: a pick session begins: turn order (actor numbers, last to the fire first) and each player's dealt hand (handSize card ids per player, in order). reason: 0 opening, 1 campfire

rows.name: PickMade
rows.purpose: a player took a card: everyone adds it to that player's cards, applies effects, advances the turn

rows.name: StateSync
rows.purpose: full card state for a late joiner or reconnecting player (counts[i] cards for actors[i], flattened in cards; pickFlags[i] = bit 1 skip next pick, bit 2 next offer is one card)

rows.name: Arrival
rows.purpose: this player first came within the campfire's rest radius: time is PhotonNetwork.Time so the host can order picks last-arrival-first

rows.name: StateRequest
rows.sender: a player who has no state yet

rows.name: CardsGranted
rows.purpose: bonus cards for a player (Double Deal / Double Down); everyone adds them to that player's collection

rows.name: SessionEnd
rows.purpose: all turns done or timed out: close waiting banners

rows.name: CardSacrificed
rows.purpose: Mountain's Bargain: the owner gave up this card; everyone removes it from that player's collection

rows.name: SkipNextPick
rows.purpose: Phoenix Clause fired: this player skips their next campfire pick

rows.name: ReviveRequest
rows.purpose: ask the host to spend an Eternal Campfire owner's per-biome revive on this scout

rows.name: ReviveGranted
rows.purpose: the host approved the revive; the downed scout revives itself

rows.name: InjuryShare
rows.purpose: Shared Burden: the card owner takes this much Injury (never re-shared)

rows.name: BonusStamina
rows.purpose: grant bonus stamina to another scout (Hero's Arrival); the receiver applies it to itself

rows.name: SpawnItem
rows.purpose: ask the host to spawn a real world pickup (Rope Baron, Supply Scout) at a safe spot

rows.name: RevivedBy
rows.purpose: tell the scout who fed you back on your feet that they revived you (Hero's Arrival)
